note: Every vscode.window.showInformationMessage/showWarningMessage call under src/ that offers MORE THAN ONE button must either be converted to a WorkflowDecisionV1/StructuredQuestionV1 posted in the chat, or be listed here with a reason it genuinely is NOT a workflow decision (task 'stage chat as a record of work', item 13 / Part 12 step 35e). A single-button call never needs an entry — the lint only flags calls that ask the user to choose between options. Entries are keyed by file:line, so a line-number drift on an untouched call is expected to surface as a stale entry on the next run — update the line, do not delete the entry, unless the call itself was removed or reduced to one button.
